subject: LangWeave Runtime Hooks & Marketplace Attribution Pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@langweave.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LangWeave x Redwood — pilot proposal for runtime hooks & attribution

Hi Jordan / Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro. LangWeave is excited to pilot a first-class integration with Redwood so ISVs on our marketplace can flow attribution and runtime telemetry back to vendors (and optionally to Redwood customers) without custom proxying.

High-level ask: we want to validate two things in a short pilot (4–6 weeks):
1) Lightweight runtime hooks in Redwood that forward an attribution header (x-langweave-attrib) and attach a stable vendor_id to trace events.
2) A tracing shim/adapter in the LangWeave SDK (LangChain/LlamaIndex flavors) that maps Redwood trace IDs to LangWeave marketplace IDs so downstream analytics and revenue attribution work.

Deliverables we envision: pilot_scope_v1.pdf (attached) with a mutual action plan, success metrics, and a short SOW. From LangWeave we’ll provide a reference LangChain adapter, a small test corpus for attribution checks, and marketplace-side webhooks.

Questions for you:
- Is Redwood comfortable exposing a small, opt-in runtime hook for marketplace integrations?
- Which trace header or ID do you prefer us to map to (x-redwood-trace / x-request-id / other)?
- Can you provide sandbox credentials we can hit from our CI to validate end-to-end flows?

Proposed next step: 30m technical sync Thursday (Dec 2) to walk the scope. I’ve copied Marketplace Ops in case there are marketplace policy considerations.

Attachments: pilot_scope_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Partnerships, LangWeave
alyssa@langweave.ai
https://langweave.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@langweave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LangWeave x Redwood — pilot proposal for runtime hooks & attribution

Alyssa — thanks, this looks promising.

Quick responses inline:
- Opt-in hooks: Yes — Redwood supports opt-in request/response hooks per route. We can add a minimal "marketplace_attrib" hook that injects/propagates x-langweave-attrib and records the mapping to our trace events (we call them rwd_trace_id).
- Preferred trace header: rwd_trace_id is our canonical trace id; we can accept mapping from x-redwood-trace or x-request-id, but for the pilot let's map x-langweave-attrib -> rwd_trace_id to avoid ambiguity.
- Sandbox creds: attaching sandbox_access_instructions.txt with short-lived API keys and an environment variable pattern for CI.

I’ve sketched a mutual action plan in the attached PDF and proposed owners. High-level milestones:
  * Week 0: Kickoff + NDA (if needed)
  * Week 1: SDK adapter PR + Redwood hook prototype (internal staging)
  * Week 2–3: E2E tests (LangWeave CI -> Redwood sandbox)
  * Week 4: Pilot demo + acceptance criteria check (attribution accuracy >= 98%)

Can Vanessa and Marissa confirm technical owners and whether we need a legal NDA before exchanging marketplace-level metadata?

I can take the Dec 2 slot you suggested; happy to shift morning or afternoon.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@langweave.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LangWeave x Redwood — pilot proposal for runtime hooks & attribution

Jordan / Alyssa — looping in a couple technical details so we can scope engineering effort.

Thanks for the clear plan. A few technical notes and open questions from runtime/instrumentation:
- Trace model: We store per-request metadata in our runtime as rwd_trace_id (UUID) and maintain per-token events keyed to that id. For the adapter mapping to be precise we need a guaranteed mapping from the LangWeave vendor_id -> rwd_trace_id at request ingress. Accepting x-langweave-attrib on ingress is OK but we need authoritative signing or short-lived ephemeral tokens if you want to avoid spoofing.
- SDK compatibility: LangWeave mentioned LangChain + LlamaIndex. Our recommended pattern is a lightweight middleware that captures the request start, reads x-langweave-attrib, and emits an association event (rwd_trace_id -> vendor_id) to our telemetry collector. A minimal patch to the LangChain adapter should be sufficient; attaching prelim_sdk_diff.patch with the suggested shim.
- Policy / marketplace: We’ll need Marketplace Ops to confirm the metadata fields allowed to flow to vendor dashboards. Alyssa — any required fields on your side beyond vendor_id and attribution_percentage?
- Model variants: If customers pin to Redwood-verified model variants (quantized vs fp32) the attribution should be agnostic, but we should confirm the sequence length ceilings for sample-checks.

Action items for Redwood runtime team (owner: Vanessa):
- Add opt-in hook for x-langweave-attrib acceptance + verify signature scheme (2 days)
- Expose small debug route for attribution lookups in sandbox (1 day)

Alyssa — if you can confirm the signing approach (HMAC with short-lived key or JWT) we’ll wire it up in staging. I’ve attached a short patch (prelim_sdk_diff.patch) that shows where the LangChain middleware would sit.

Thanks — talk Thu.

Thanks Vanessa — that patch looks exactly like what we had in mind. HMAC short-lived keys work best for us (less token churn than JWTs for CI), and we can rotate keys per-customer in the marketplace.

Confirmed: we’re good to proceed with the Dec 2 technical sync — sorry for the timezone confusion, we meant Thu Dec 2 and will take that slot. Proposal: joint demo 12/07 at 10:00am PT to show E2E attribution with a sample marketplace listing and a sandbox Redwood customer.

A few final notes:
- We’ve uploaded a signed NDA and the pilot SOW to the Drive link and attached a redacted marketplace policy doc (langweave_redwood_ndaconf.pdf).
- Marketplace Ops: Sam / team, please confirm that vendor_id + attribution_percentage + rwd_trace_id are an approved set for vendor dashboards.

Action items (recap):
  * LangWeave: push LangChain adapter PR + test corpus (owner: Alyssa) — target Dec 6
  * Redwood: enable marketplace_attrib hook in staging + provide sandbox API key (owner: Jordan/Vanessa) — target Dec 4
  * Legal: finalize NDA (if required) — target Dec 3
  * Ops/Marketplace: approve metadata flow (owner: Marketplace Ops) — target Dec 3

See you on the sync — thanks all.

Alyssa Chen
Head of Partnerships, LangWeave
alyssa@langweave.ai
